obfuscation_indicators: expect to supply for many years
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and well quantified, including production, pricing, costs, capital expenditures, liquidity, reimbursements, and reserve sensitivities. Key risks include declining volumes, higher operating costs, dependence on coal-fired utilities, customer reimbursement uncertainty, and reliance on reserve estimates, while management maintains an optimistic outlook for ILB coal demand.
